topic: 浮卡滚动失效（手势系统/隐藏规则/canvas 手势注册表）
text:
**用户：**
还是不行，现在左右有手势了，但上下依然不能滚动，这是上下手势的日志：[13:55:40.609] [swipe] dx: -0 axis: none snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.616] [swipe] dx: -0 axis: none snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.624] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.632] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.641] [swipe] dx: -1 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.649] [swipe] dx: -2 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.657] [swipe] dx: -2 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.666] [swipe] dx: -2 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.674] [swipe] dx: -2 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.683] [swipe] dx: -3 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.691] [swipe] dx: -3 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.699] [swipe] dx: -3 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.710] [swipe] dx: -3 axis: vertical snap: both-closed → [13:55:40.710] [gesture] END, type: pointerup handler: gestures-page-swipe dx: -3 → [13:55:42.197] [gesture] END, type: pointerup handler: gestures-page-swipe dx: 0

**AI：**
浏览器**在滚动**，但 Chrome 的一个行为是：`touch-action: pan-y` 允许滚动，却**不同时抑制 `pointermove`**。所以手势系统收到指针事件，日志里看到 `[swipe]`，但实际浏览器也在滚——只是滚动发生在你看不到的元素上。

问题出在滚动目标。浮卡 DOM 链里有两层 `overflow-y: auto`：`contentEl` 和 `scrollArea`。浏览器找到的是 `contentEl`（先碰到的），但 `contentEl` 的子元素（`wrap` 用 `position:absolute` 撑满）从不溢出——所以看起来没滚。

把 `contentEl` 的 `overflow-y: auto` 去掉，让浏览器直接找到 `scrollArea`：
改了一行：`contentEl` 的 `overflow-y: auto` → `overflow: hidden`。浏览器现在会跳过它，直接找到 `scrollArea` 作为滚动目标。而 `touch-action: pan-y` 从外层 `el` 一路继承到 `scrollArea`。

硬刷新试。
